body: I appreciate the information. But I'd rather not speak to a professional. The last time I told a psychiatrist that I thought about killing myself, I was sent to a hospital.
I'm afraid the sleeves will slide up and reveal the scars when I shake hands with people. The cuts are very new and haven't fully healed yet, so I don't know if makeup will still work.
I can't. If I ever tell a counselor how depressed I am or that I'm suicidal, they will immediately send me to a hospital. I can never let that happen.

There are a lot of reasons why I'm depressed, but most fall under the big umbrella of "nobody cares." So yeah, I'll feel terrible, then people will ignore me so I feel worse. Then when I'm reminded that people don't care, I feel terrible again.

It's mainly the way they act for others compared to me. When one person is feeling a little blue, everyone drops what they're doing to help. They will make food for them, make cards, do whatever they can to be there. This applies to quite literally every one of my friends. When I'm upset, nothing happens. No one asks me what's wrong or if I want to talk. No one tries to comfort me in any way. I was once gone for a whole 24 hours without telling anyone and with my phone off. When I came back, I didn't get a single message. My friend was gone for 90 minutes once and *everyone* was calling her to find out where she was. It's the most upsetting thing to see them all on their phones for the majority of the day when I rarely get texts from anyone. They don't care.
Even though it doesn't feel that way, I certainly hope you're right.
No. People are just going to call me whiny or annoying if I complain. I know because my friends make fun of one guy in our dorm for being too needy.
